title: Consumption Waterfall Compiler for Model/Route/Customer Attribution
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a durable, explainable "consumption waterfall" compiler that materializes per-request and aggregated breakdowns of compute/latency cost across route -> model variant -> customer dimensions. This service will be the canonical backend for Console's cost and latency drilldowns and for billing-attribution tooling. It must support streaming ingestion for near-real-time dashboards and efficient backfills for historical queries.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming pipeline produces per-minute materialized windows (route, model_variant, tenant) with cost and latency components within 3% of offline baseline for synthetic workloads
Query API supports ad-hoc breakdowns (route/model/tenant) with 95th percentile latency < 300ms for 30-day rolling aggregates
Backfill job can reprocess 90 days of telemetry in < 36 hours using cluster autoscaling configuration
Attribution includes KV-cache hit accounting, router overhead, and model compute (token-level) components; missing fields are flagged and fall back to best-effort attribution
Integration tests and benchmark harness added; PR with benchmarks merged before canary rollout
implementation_steps: Spike: design logical model for waterfall rows and canonical schema (request_id, route_id, model_tag, tenant_id, token_compute_ns, kv_cache_hits, infra_overhead_ns, timestamp)
Define protobuf/avro wire schema and topic partition strategy; add version field for schema evolution
Build streaming join between runtime trace stream and billing-meter events (kafka streams/Tumbling-window join) with sanity checks for clock skew
Aggregator service: perform incremental compilation into minute/hour/day materialized tables (ClickHouse for hot, BigQuery for cold), expose incremental diffs for console
Backfill tool: implement shard-aware reprocessor with idempotent writes and compaction
Expose Query API (gRPC + REST) with pagination, aggregation filters, and attribution explain endpoint that returns causal-span hints
Add e2e dashboards: correctness checks, missing-field rates, pipeline lag, and cost-skew alerts
Canary roll: route 5% of console queries to new aggregator with automatic fallback to existing rollups
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: double-counting when requests are retried -> mitigate with deterministic request fingerprinting and dedupe window
Risk: schema churn across model variants -> mitigate with version field and compatibility tests in CI
Risk: joins amplify latency -> mitigate with hybrid strategy: partial in-stream enrichment and eventual consistency for full attribution
Risk: noisy tenant billing spikes -> add smoothing and anomaly detection before surfacing to Console to avoid false alarms
notes: This ticket focuses on the computation and storage tier; Console UI work and billing export are tracked in separate PM tickets. We'll use ClickHouse materialized views for minute-level hot paths and BigQuery for long-tail analytics and billing exports. The design emphasizes explainability: each aggregate row should be traceable back to the contributing spans/records.
